final:
-- Spec phase: config_value returns the value for `key` in `name=value`
-- per-line text, or "" when the key is absent. Pure: no capabilities.

config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  pre key.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex config_value("host=local\nport=8080", "port") == "8080"
  ex config_value("host=local\nport=8080", "user") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    if parts.len() >= 2 and parts[0] == key
      var value = ""
      for i in range(1, parts.len())
        if i > 1
          value += "="
        value += parts[i]
      return value
  ""

test_config_value() =
  assert config_value("host=local\nport=8080", "host") == "local"
  assert config_value("", "host") == ""
